title: BH | Premier Saint-Antoine Shagreen Bedside Table
descriptionHtml:
For centuries the cabinetmakers of the Faubourg Saint-Antoine, the old furniture quarter on the eastern edge of Paris, made the small tables that stood beside French beds, ready for a candle, a book and whatever was needed before sleep. This bedside table keeps that nightly ritual close at hand. Its top is wide enough for a lamp, a glass of water and the novel you are halfway through, and its drawers keep the rest of the nightly clutter out of sight.

The case is wrapped all over in leather embossed with the pebbled grain of shagreen, the finish the French still call galuchat, and the hardware is finished in gold. At 30 inches tall it sits at an easy reach from most beds, and it arrives fully assembled.

Use a pair either side of a king or queen bed, each with a lamp and a little dish for rings and a phone, or set one at the end of a sofa, where it does the same quiet job in a living room. This listing is for one bedside table.
